rv.q: This dame makes a hell of a Queen.
Happily, Zeldin 's script is also very funny: understated but wincingly convincing in the manner of the best TV mockumentaries.
The problem really is Morgan's blandly amusing but desperately trivial script.

cn.t: Scott Thomas capably succeeds Mirren in this well-crafted but somewhat diffuse portrait of the Queen's audiences with prime ministers, offering a fascinating performance in Morgan's affectionate if uneven play.
